findings.reasoningSummary: MEDIUM deliberation chosen following R47 open gap. Source 163/input 127 unchanged, core/learner/AST/Config/initial 0.5/typed source/order/guards/controller/history/Cost unchanged. Eight frozen bijections realized by inverse vocabulary to original R37 runtime across 112 grounded 8-token sources, no monkeypatch/host semantic repair. 32 base cases across Parts I-III (16 Part I c_mask=0..15 lattice, 8 Part II diagonal/anti-diagonal counterexamples, 8 Part III L-shaped counterexamples) achieve 8/8 distinct restricted maps (0 unchanged pairs, 224 changed case pairs, 448 changed numeric arm pairs), 64/64 ordered code pairs, 16/16 ordered Hamming pairs, and 56/56 cross-domain fact pairs per codebook. Invalid maps and collapsed coverage reject; authored encoding not learner.

Each role Program/drive input/cfg/initial and all physical refs/full scalar/controller/Cost/source proof/slot/revision/final consumer checked. 64 numeric role inputs partition into 4 exact Hamming equivalence classes d in {0,1,2,3} (max within-class spread 1.0408340855860843e-17); 40320 bijections/2580480 saved lookups/0 wrong at role stage. 16 pair settles exhaust all 4^2 Hamming pairs (16/16 correct, 645120 bijection-class checks with 0 wrong). 121 or0..4 (121/121), 32 projection0/1 (32/32, collapsing 16 masks to 10 closure signatures), 64 feasible4 (64/64), and 512 query4 (512/512) extremal envelope settles verify [false_max, true_min] boundary intervals without claiming 64^n enumeration. Full pipeline 256 native_joint (256/256 truth), 256 native_marginal (256/256 closure, 128/256 truth, 128 abstentions, 0 false assertions), 256 exact_joint, and 448 paired conditions/448 invariant, finite adoption=true; isometric 128/128 state_sha256 equal vs non-isometric 220/320 state_sha256 changed; 100% of upper tick differences confined to role_ticks while pair/membership/projection/feasible4/query4 ticks are invariant (true). Max scalar error 1.3877787807814457e-17; 25/25 mutations rejected catching ValueError only.

33753 actual settles/1020630 ticks/80.6737136390002s within 240s stage/600s total, worker 1/retry 0. All three stages (preparation, work, audit) exited with returncode 0 on the first server run (status=COMPLETED). Full source(112)/transfer(809, including 64 role)/upper(32832) call ledger, bounded aggregate cache 128MiB/raw 128MiB/AS 512MiB each/record 128KiB/unique 1428<6000. Complete computed kernel+Config bytes confirm storage-only dedup; all calculations run. All phase CPU+parent seal+launcher measured=80.638476501; core/storage/source/transfer subset times not double added; no efficiency adoption gate or posthoc performance claim. All 1460 non-empty files + manifest directly match original manifest size/SHA; 6 empty logs/ZIP not received, manifest outside own hash/upstream unknown/same-channel not attestation. Author CS review is not independent audit.
